key.name: searxng-instance
key.description:
Origin of the SearXNG instance queried for the sidebar's link list, for example 'http://localhost:8888'. Only http and https addresses are accepted; any path, query, or fragment is ignored. The instance must have 'json' listed under search.formats in its settings.yml.
The list comes from SearXNG rather than direct scraping because search engines gate their result pages against non-browser clients. SearXNG spreads a query across many upstreams and degrades gracefully when one refuses.

key.name: panel-engine
key.description: Which engine's results page is rendered. DuckDuckGo's HTML endpoint renders reliably. Google is offered because its results are wanted, but it answers many networks (VPN exits in particular) with its "unusual traffic" check; the page detects that and reports it instead of trying to get past it.

key.name: panel-sidebar-visible
key.description: Whether the compact list of result links is shown beside the rendered page. Off by default: the page already lists the results, so the sidebar is supplementary. The sidebar button and F9 toggle the same key, so the choice persists.

key.name: panel-sidebar-position
key.description: Which side of the rendered page the sidebar is docked to.

key.name: panel-sidebar-width
key.description: Width of the sidebar in logical pixels.

key.name: panel-sidebar-limit
key.description: Maximum number of links listed in the sidebar.
